2018 Q4.gq: Global production forecast for 2018 were reduced again from growth of 0.7% to a decline of 1% since our last earnings call.
2018 Q4.bq: Regarding our balance sheet and cash flows, fourth quarter free cash flow was $220 million to drive full year free cash flow to $362 million above our guidance range that we offered in October.

2020 Q4.bq: Fourth quarter net sales beat our guidance of the year-over-year decrease of 6.8% with upside, driven by strong underlying demand and industrial coatings and ongoing recovery seen in Light Vehicle within Transportation Coatings.

2021 Q2.bq: The reported net sales increase of 72.6% was ahead of our prior expectations, as recovery in Refinish as well as strong industrial demand more than offset that persistent production headwinds with our Mobility customers.

2021 Q3.bq: In dollar terms, Mobility Coatings is expected to be impacted by approximately $70 million in net sales in the fourth quarter, and $215 million for the full year from continued supply chain impacts, which is $80 million higher than our previous forecast from July.

2021 Q4.bq: The fourth-quarter impact was also 1.4 million vehicles below the high end of the forecasted range of potential production impacts from October 2021.

2022 Q1.bq: Despite the approximately $22 million in earning headwinds, these three items created versus our January guidance framework, we were still able to deliver a solid quarter and exceed our sales guidance. as strong pricing and better volumes yielded better-than-expected 10% year-over-year organic ex FX growth and also delivered EBIT at the top end of our range.

2022 Q2.bq: In the quarter, we achieved adjusted EBIT of $151 million and adjusted earnings per share of $0.41, both of which were above the midpoint of our expectations we set out in our Q1 earnings call despite incremental headwinds of $8 million associated with foreign currency and China lockdowns, both of which were higher than our original expectations.

2025 Q4.bq: Adjusted EBITDA in the quarter was $272 million, down slightly from last year and lower than our guidance expectations as December volumes in both refinish and industrial came in lower than anticipated.

2026 Q3.bq: While our performance in the quarter remained strong, results were below our expectations, driven primarily by softer volumes in Europe refinish.
